decision_scope: service diagnostic only; no scientific evidence, hypothesis, plan, scoring seed, candidate, benchmark, schema or scoring

prior_evidence.EXP-20260830-0040: a one-selector learned SPN was numerically identical to contextual Chow-Liu and strictly more costly; revival requires at least two recursive levels and stronger classical controls
prior_evidence.SRC-SPN: smooth/decomposable circuits support tractable conditional inference but circuit compactness alone is not a learned advantage
prior_evidence.SRC-structure-learning: published SPN structure learning motivates data-driven recursive partitions, not exemption from mixture-tree and decision-diagram controls

prohibited_shortcuts: WT test files 8-9 or any three-family test target
family labels, native types, paths, semantic response-channel names or three-family mask/native-width routing
post-diagnostic changes to response signature, split rule, ridge, variance floor or thresholds

wt_development_diagnostic.response_signature: mean(target rows 0:16) minus mean(history rows 16:32), retaining all ten anonymous coordinates
wt_development_diagnostic.observable_context: sort the four normalized public control values; root split is lower two versus upper two and the second level separates the two values within each branch

models.depth0: one Gaussian Chow-Liu tree for all fit signatures
models.depth1: one Gaussian Chow-Liu tree for each root branch
models.depth2: one Gaussian Chow-Liu tree for each of the four control leaves

wt_development_diagnostic.tree_fit: maximum absolute-correlation spanning tree, rooted at anonymous coordinate 0; each child is a ridge-0.001 conditional Gaussian on its parent, with variance floor 0.001
wt_development_diagnostic.development_metric: mean Gaussian negative log likelihood per anonymous coordinate, overall and separately in files 6 and 7

structure_hierarchy.root_shared_edges: intersection of all four leaf edge sets
structure_hierarchy.branch_specific_edges: within-branch leaf intersection excluding root-shared edges
structure_hierarchy.split_stability: mean Jaccard agreement of root-shared and both branch-specific edge sets between fit files 0-2 and 3-5

contract_gates.required_distinction: a future recursive PC must be smaller or cheaper at matched calibrated likelihood than a flat mixture with parameter sharing, a decision diagram/tensor train and generic variable elimination; merely nesting four Chow-Liu leaves cannot pass

overall_pass_rule: all WT numerical gates pass and an existing frozen contract expresses a recursive circuit distinction that is not exactly a flat mixture/decision tree and does not use mask routing; otherwise keep HYP-0013 dormant and create no hypothesis

outcomes.pass: a later wake may create one low-confidence hypothesis before implementation or scoring
outcomes.fail: record no_recursive_pc_structure_contract and create no hypothesis, candidate, plan, benchmark or schema
